verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments platform/API, not an AI agent or assistant product; the evidence only shows Finix exposing its own MCP server for external AI agents to query its API (finix-docs-21, finix-probe-2), not Finix itself consuming or plugging in external MCP servers to gain new tool capabilities. This client-side 'plug MCP servers in' story is a category mismatch for a payments SaaS with no agentic core.
